headline: Arena Archery: the bot climbs like it means it
lede: The autopilot now scales the towers on purpose — and the audit found that the towers were never climbable in the first place.

notes.text: Reachability is now physics, not commentary: every hop candidate is replayed through the real moveBody before the bot commits (run-up at speed, take-off 2–5 cells out, land on the slab — or no deal).

The shipped arenas were quietly unclimbable: two-row slabs needed 58 px of rise, the jump actually gives 51, and the closed-form contract said 48 and passed. All three arenas re-carved to the measured apex; THE NEST returns with a sniper cupola reachable only by arrow.

archerycheck 146/146 with eight mutants dead — new CLIMBS receipts (grounded-row to grounded-row, 10–18 rows climbed per arena) and a climbSeek:false mutant. Slack, determinism and the every-tick arrow ledger unchanged.
QA polish pass #2314 open: climb juice (land dust, thuds), the missing landing/blocked-hop sounds, and the first real 2P playthrough.

look.text: Watch the autopilot chain five floors of KNOCKBACK in the attract demo
